statement.notes: Only the 'Depreciation of property and equipment' line item was directly mapped to the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field. The supplementary tables contain detailed lease information, but the primary cash flow statement does not break out amortization of intangible assets or lease-related depreciation separately. Therefore, only the explicit depreciation figure from the operating activities adjustments is included. The 'Other' line in adjustments may contain some amortization, but its composition is unspecified, so it is not included to maintain accuracy.
